race.description: Book Your Xmas Party At Plrc Mdn Plate
race.comment: CRIMSON WALTZ (8) gets the nod after going within a nose of Bouzy's Babe at this track last start, having also been beaten just under two lengths at this venue the run prior. She has been building steadily through the campaign and the recent form line makes her the one to beat. INITIALLY (4) is the obvious danger, with a second and a third from his past two starts at this track, both by narrow margins, and his record of two placings from two attempts at the distance reads well for a Mdn of this depth. UNCOMMON MIND (11) has placed at her past two runs, including a third behind Offa's Dyke last start, and brings reliable track form with a 2kg claim to help. EGYPTIANS REIGN (2) has to rebound sharply from a plain last at Bordertown, but he has placed at this distance before and is rated well enough on time to stay in the mix. GOLDEN BASILICA (7) won't be far away from an inside barrier.
